title: Karma Police
feel: Piano-led; the acoustic strum doubles it

sections.name: Intro / Verse
sections.bars: Am D/F# | Em G | Am F | Em G | Am D | G . C C/B | Am | Bm D

sections.name: Chorus
sections.bars: C D | G F# | C D | G F# | C D | G | Bm C | Bm D

sections.name: Outro
sections.bars: Bm D | G D | G D | E

why: A **secondary dominant**: F♯ (V of Bm) inside a G-major chorus, plus the Dorian IV (D over Am) in the verse.
hard_change: **G → F♯ barre** in the chorus. From the 3x0003 G grip, the barre lands one fret lower — aim the index first.
theory: Verse i–IV6–v–VII (Dorian, from the major IV). Chorus IV–V–I–V/iii. The outro tonicises B minor.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: C → D → G → F♯.
